steps.en: Install one skill into the current Android project
steps.zh: 把一个 skill 装进当前工程

steps.en: Drops SKILL.md plus references and scripts into the project's agent dirs
steps.zh: 把 SKILL.md、references 和脚本放进 agent 目录

steps.en: Ask the agent the matching job in plain language
steps.zh: 用自然语言把这件活交给 agent

steps.en: Loads the skill from its description and follows the vendor playbook
steps.zh: 按描述匹配并加载 skill，按厂商剧本执行

steps.en: Review the report or proposed change; the agent does not gate it
steps.zh: 审报告或拟议改动，agent 不把门

value.en: Google's current Android playbook on the jobs where models still fail, without you pasting docs each time
value.zh: 在模型仍会失手的那些活上，拿到 Google 当前的 Android 剧本，而不必每次自己贴文档

sources: https://github.com/android/skills README.md — `android skills add r8-analyzer --project=.`, `android skills add --all`, auto-activate example "Make my app UI edge-to-edge."
https://developer.android.com/tools/agents/android-skills — install via Android CLI, activate by prompting the related task, Android Studio `@skill-name`
performance/r8-analyzer/SKILL.md — Path A/B/C analysis, "No code changes: Research and suggest only"
